title: In the first successful US prosecution of a spyware operator in 10+ years, pcTattletale founder pleads guilty to promoting surveillance apps for unlawful uses (Zack Whittaker/TechCrunch)
summary: Zack Whittaker / TechCrunch: In the first successful US prosecution of a spyware operator in 10+ years, pcTattletale founder pleads guilty to promoting surveillance apps for unlawful uses — The founder of a U.S.-based spyware company, whose surveillance products allowed customers to spy on the phones and computers …
